parsers.name: vtk_unstructured
parsers.purpose: Read GEOS VTK UnstructuredGrid cell/point data and PVD timestep collections.

parsers.name: geos_stdout_tables
parsers.purpose: Parse GEOS TableTextFormatter ASCII tables and CFL lines from solver stdout.

parsers.name: hdf5_time_history
parsers.purpose: Read GEOS TimeHistory / PackCollection HDF5. Pair each field with '<field> Time' (n,1) raveled. phaseVolumeFraction is (time, cell, phase).

parsers.name: sidre_restart
parsers.purpose: Inspect GEOS Sidre/Conduit Restart HDF5. Numeric payloads live in datasets named __values__ under a field group.

parsers.name: seismo_trace_vector
parsers.purpose: Read a 3-component receiver trace stored as three concatenated index-time-value blocks (x, then y, then z).
